headline: As of 2026-10-07: 1,772,445 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 32 of 50 states, D+30.9 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,772,445 early/mail ballots cast so far across 32 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+30.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (422,252), Florida (274,575), Michigan (252,707).
